AdminAccount.title: Account & security
AdminAccount.subtitle: Password, two-factor authentication and active sessions of the SUPER_ADMIN account.
AdminAccount.mustChangeBody: For security, replace the generated initial password before using the rest of the console.
AdminAccount.passwordNever: The password has never been changed.
AdminAccount.passwordSaved: Password updated. Your other sessions were signed out.
AdminAccount.mfaDisabled: Two-factor authentication is not enabled. We strongly recommend enabling it.
AdminAccount.mfaScan: Scan this QR code with your authenticator app, or enter the setup key manually.
AdminAccount.mfaRecoveryBody: Store these codes in a safe place. Each code can be used once if you lose access to your authenticator app. They will not be shown again.
AdminAccount.mfaDisableLabel: Confirm your password to disable two-factor authentication

mfaErrors.INVALID_CODE: Invalid code. Check the time on your device and try again.

passwordErrors.TOO_SHORT: The password must contain at least 12 characters.
passwordErrors.MISMATCH: The two passwords do not match.
